label: ha device
description: Makes this board a Home Assistant device over MQTT: its ha nodes appear under it, it shows offline in HA when the board drops off. Sends HA's own status (online/offline) when it changes. One per flow.

properties.name: deviceName
properties.label: device name
properties.help: The name HA shows. Empty: the board's hostname.

properties.name: area
properties.label: area
properties.help: Suggested HA area, e.g. Kitchen. Optional.
